zh.loginSub: 在浏览器中完成登录，然后回到这里。
zh.waitTitle: 在浏览器中确认此代码
zh.waitSub: 浏览器已打开授权页面。确认代码一致后点击“授权”。
zh.browserFailD: 请手动访问以下地址并输入代码。
zh.errExpiredD: 请重新登录以获取新的代码。
zh.errDeniedD: 你在浏览器中拒绝了此设备的授权。
zh.errNetD: 请检查网络连接后重试。
zh.errLockedT: 钥匙串或钥匙环已锁定
zh.conflictD: {app} 正在接管本机网络，同时使用可能无法连接。建议先关闭它的增强模式或系统代理。
zh.sysproxyUnavailable: 此桌面环境不支持设置系统代理。请改用增强模式，或在应用中手动填写本地代理。
zh.d_authorizing: 首次开启需要安装系统服务，请在系统对话框中输入管理员密码。
zh.d_occupied: 此账户的增强模式正在另一台设备上使用。
zh.d_disconnecting: 正在恢复系统网络设置
zh.fr_timeout: 所有线路均无法连接（连接超时）。
zh.fr_routesTakenOver: 另一个 VPN 或程序反复改动本机路由，已停止自动重连，以免和它来回争抢。请先关闭它再重试，或改用兼容模式。
zh.fr_auth: 未获得管理员授权，系统服务未安装。
zh.proxyNote: 在应用中填写即可单独使用所选节点
zh.proxyNoteRouted: 在应用中填写即可按分流规则使用代理
zh.editRoutingRulesD: 在浏览器中打开，显示网页当前所在空间的规则（可在网页左上角切换空间）；保存后各设备自动同步。
zh.noSubD: 购买订阅后即可连接节点。
zh.expiredD: 你的订阅已于 {d} 到期，续费后即可恢复连接。
zh.teamOffD: “{team}”已被管理员停用。切换到其他团队以继续使用。
zh.cfgD: 最新的节点配置无法解析，正在继续使用之前的配置。
zh.copyHttp: 复制 HTTP 代理地址
zh.copySocks: 复制 SOCKS5 代理地址
zh.loadingD: 正在从服务器同步节点列表。
zh.invalidD: 无法解析节点配置，且没有可用的历史配置。请刷新节点或联系支持。
zh.launchApprove: 需要在“系统设置 › 通用 › 登录项”中允许 PPVPN。
zh.signOutD: 增强模式将被关闭，本地代理停止服务。
zh.apiHint: 仅供开发调试。留空则使用默认地址。
zh.uninstallD: 会关闭增强模式，需要管理员密码。
zh.authMacT: PPVPN 正在尝试安装新的帮助程序。
zh.authMacD: 输入密码以允许此操作。
zh.uacQ: 你要允许此应用对你的设备进行更改吗？
zh.winLaunchApprove: 已在“设置 › 应用 › 启动”中被关闭，需要在那里重新开启。
zh.stillRunningD: 可以从通知区域的图标重新打开主窗口。
zh.stdDesc: 标准模式，遵循系统代理的应用可用
zh.fr_port: 无法写入系统代理设置，可能已被其他软件接管。
zh.proxyOffNote: 标准模式已关闭，本地代理当前不可用。开启标准模式后恢复。
zh.needInstall: 首次使用需要安装系统服务
zh.installT: 安装 PPVPN 系统服务
zh.installD: 增强模式需要一个后台系统服务来接管本机网络。安装时系统会要求输入管理员密码，之后开启或关闭增强模式无需再次授权。
zh.msgEmptyD: 订阅、账单和线路相关的通知会显示在这里。
zh.msgErrD: 请检查网络连接后重试。
zh.polkitD: 安装 PPVPN 系统服务需要管理员权限。
zh.polkitDu: 移除 PPVPN 系统服务需要管理员权限。
zh.aboutLicense: PPVPN 是自由软件，按 GNU 通用公共许可证第 3 版或（由你选择）任何更高版本发布。本程序不提供任何担保。
zh.nodesHint: 双击设为当前节点 · 右键查看更多
zh.proxyRoutedD: 按分流规则直连或经当前节点，跟随规则/全局模式。
zh.proxyNodeD: 全部经当前节点，不看分流规则。
zh.rulesUnavailableD: 部分分流规则暂未加载，相关流量暂时走代理。
zh.ingressDownD: {n} 已固定使用 {r}，该入口暂时不可用。
zh.pinClearedD: {n} 固定的线路已不在配置中，已恢复自动。
zh.proxyResetD: 本地代理的用户名和密码已重新生成。使用它的应用（如浏览器扩展）需要重新复制。
zh.routesReplacedD: 另一个 VPN 的路由已被临时接管，断开后恢复。
zh.Error_NetworkUnreachable: 无法连接到服务器，请检查网络连接。
zh.Error_ServerUnavailable: 服务器暂时不可用，请稍后再试。
zh.Error_RateLimited: 请求过于频繁，请稍后再试。
zh.Error_AuthExpired: 登录代码已过期，请重新登录。
zh.Error_AuthDenied: 已在浏览器中拒绝授权。
zh.Error_AuthSessionInvalid: 登录已失效，请重新登录。
zh.Error_AuthBrowserOpenFailed: 无法打开浏览器，请手动访问授权页面并输入代码。
zh.Error_CredentialStoreFailed: 无法读写系统凭据存储中的登录信息。
zh.Error_NoSubscription: 当前团队没有有效的订阅。
zh.Error_ProfileInvalid: 节点配置无效，请联系客服。
zh.Error_NodeNotFound: 所选节点已不可用，请重新选择。
zh.Error_IcmpNotPermitted: 系统不允许 Ping 测速，请改用 TCP。
zh.Error_ServiceInstallCancelled: 已取消安装系统服务，增强模式需要该服务。
zh.Error_ServiceUnavailable: 系统服务未运行，请重试。
zh.Error_ServiceIncompatible: 系统服务版本不兼容，请重新安装 PPVPN。
zh.Error_ServiceBusy: 增强模式正在此账户的另一个会话中使用。
zh.Error_ConnectFailed: 无法通过该节点建立连接。
zh.Error_NetworkPathContended: 其他 VPN 或代理接管了系统网络，请先关闭后重试。
zh.Error_Internal: 发生内部错误，请联系客服。
zh.Error_LocalStorageFailed: 无法保存本地数据，请检查磁盘空间和权限。
zh.Error_AuthUntrustedResponse: 登录响应无法验证，请重试。
zh.Error_ProfileExpired: 节点配置已过期，正在重新获取。
zh.Error_ServiceClientRejected: 系统服务拒绝了此应用，请重新安装 PPVPN。
zh.Error_ServiceOwnedByAnotherUser: 增强模式正被这台电脑上的其他系统用户使用，无法在此接管。
zh.Error_NotSignedIn: 登录已失效，请重新登录。
zh.Error_StandardNotReady: 本地代理尚未就绪，请稍候。
zh.connMethodHint: 连接中切换会以新的方式重新连接。
zh.methodEnhancedD: 所有应用可用。首次使用需要安装系统服务。
zh.methodCompatibleD: 设置系统代理，遵循系统代理的应用可用。无需管理员权限。
zh.routingRulesD: 按分流规则选择直连或代理。
zh.routingGlobalD: 除局域网外，全部流量经节点。
zh.Error_SystemProxyFailed: 无法写入系统代理设置，可能已被其他软件接管。
zh.Error_ConnectHealthCheckFailed: 连接后无法访问服务，可能是 DNS 或网络被其他软件接管。
zh.Error_CredentialStoreLocked: 钥匙串或钥匙环已锁定，解锁后会自动恢复登录。
zh.Error_SystemProxyUnavailable: 此桌面环境不支持设置系统代理。请改用增强模式，或在应用中手动填写本地代理。

en.loginSub: Finish signing in in your browser, then come back here.
en.waitTitle: Confirm this code in your browser
en.waitSub: Your browser opened the authorization page. Make sure the code matches, then click Authorize.
en.browserFailD: Open this address manually and enter the code.
en.errExpiredD: Sign in again to get a new code.
en.errDeniedD: Authorization for this device was denied in the browser.
en.errNetD: Check your network connection and try again.
en.conflictD: {app} is routing this device’s traffic. Using both may fail; turn off its enhanced mode or system proxy first.
en.sysproxyUnavailable: This desktop doesn't expose system proxy settings. Use Enhanced Mode, or enter the local proxy in your apps.
en.d_authorizing: First-time setup installs a system service. Enter your administrator password in the system dialog.
en.d_occupied: Enhanced Mode for this account is active on another device.
en.fr_timeout: All routes failed to connect (timed out).
en.fr_routesTakenOver: Another VPN or app keeps changing this device's routes, so automatic reconnecting has stopped rather than fight it. Turn it off and retry, or use compatibility mode.
en.fr_auth: Administrator authorization was not granted. The system service was not installed.
en.proxyNote: Enter in an app to use the selected node on its own
en.proxyNoteRouted: Enter in an app to proxy it by the routing rules
en.editRoutingRulesD: Opens in your browser for the team the website is on (switch it at the top left of the web page); devices pick up saved rules automatically.
en.noSubD: Buy a subscription to start connecting to nodes.
en.expiredD: Your subscription expired on {d}. Renew to reconnect.
en.teamOffD: “{team}” was disabled by its admin. Switch to another team to continue.
en.cfgD: The latest node configuration couldn’t be parsed. Still using the previous configuration.
en.loadingD: Syncing the node list from the server.
en.invalidD: The node configuration couldn’t be parsed and no previous configuration is available. Refresh nodes or contact support.
en.launchApprove: Allow PPVPN in System Settings › General › Login Items.
en.signOutD: Enhanced Mode will turn off and the local proxy will stop.
en.apiHint: For development only. Leave empty to use the default.
en.uninstallD: Turns off Enhanced Mode. Requires an administrator password.
en.authMacT: PPVPN is trying to install a new helper tool.
en.authMacD: Enter your password to allow this.
en.uacQ: Do you want to allow this app to make changes to your device?
en.winLaunchApprove: Turned off in Settings › Apps › Startup. Turn it back on there.
en.stillRunningD: Reopen the main window from the icon in the notification area.
en.stdDesc: Standard mode, for apps that use system proxy
en.fr_port: Couldn’t apply system proxy settings. Another app may be managing them.
en.proxyOffNote: Standard Mode is off, so the local proxy is unavailable. Turn on Standard Mode to restore it.
en.needInstall: First-time use requires installing a system service
en.installD: Enhanced Mode needs a background system service to route this device’s traffic. You’ll be asked for an administrator password once; turning Enhanced Mode on or off afterwards won’t ask again.
en.msgEmptyD: Notices about your subscription, billing and routes will appear here.
en.msgErrD: Check your network connection and try again.
en.polkitD: Administrator privileges are required to install the PPVPN system service.
en.polkitDu: Administrator privileges are required to remove the PPVPN system service.
en.aboutLicense: PPVPN is free software, released under the GNU General Public License, version 3 or (at your option) any later version. It comes with ABSOLUTELY NO WARRANTY.
en.nodesHint: Double-click to set as current · Right-click for more
en.proxyRoutedD: Direct or through the current node as the routing rules say; follows Rules / Global.
en.proxyNodeD: Everything through the current node, regardless of the rules.
en.rulesUnavailableD: Some routing rules haven't loaded yet; that traffic goes through the proxy for now.
en.ingressDownD: {n} is pinned to {r}, which is unavailable right now.
en.pinClearedD: The route pinned for {n} is no longer offered; it's back to automatic.
en.proxyResetD: The local proxy's user names and passwords were regenerated. Apps that use it, such as a browser extension, need them copied again.
en.routesReplacedD: Another VPN's routes are taken over for now; they're restored when you disconnect.
en.Error_NetworkUnreachable: Can't reach the server. Check your internet connection.
en.Error_ServerUnavailable: The server is temporarily unavailable. Try again later.
en.Error_RateLimited: Too many requests. Try again in a moment.
en.Error_AuthExpired: The sign-in code expired. Please sign in again.
en.Error_AuthDenied: Authorization was declined in the browser.
en.Error_AuthSessionInvalid: Your session is no longer valid. Please sign in again.
en.Error_AuthBrowserOpenFailed: Couldn't open the browser. Open the authorization page manually and enter the code.
en.Error_CredentialStoreFailed: Couldn't read or save your sign-in in the system credential store.
en.Error_NoSubscription: The current team has no active subscription.
en.Error_ProfileInvalid: The node configuration is invalid. Please contact support.
en.Error_NodeNotFound: The selected node is no longer available. Choose another one.
en.Error_IcmpNotPermitted: Ping isn't permitted on this system. Use TCP instead.
en.Error_ServiceInstallCancelled: Installation was cancelled. Enhanced Mode needs the system service.
en.Error_ServiceUnavailable: The system service isn't running. Try again.
en.Error_ServiceIncompatible: The system service is incompatible. Please reinstall PPVPN.
en.Error_ServiceBusy: Enhanced Mode is in use in another session of this account.
en.Error_NetworkPathContended: Another VPN or proxy took over the network. Turn it off and try again.
en.Error_Internal: An internal error occurred. Please contact support.
en.Error_LocalStorageFailed: Couldn't save local data. Check disk space and permissions.
en.Error_AuthUntrustedResponse: The sign-in response couldn't be verified. Try again.
en.Error_ProfileExpired: The node configuration expired and is being refreshed.
en.Error_ServiceUninstallCancelled: Uninstalling the system service was cancelled.
en.Error_ServiceClientRejected: The system service rejected this app. Reinstall PPVPN.
en.Error_TeamDisabled: The current team has been disabled.
en.Error_ServiceOwnedByAnotherUser: Enhanced Mode is in use by another user on this computer and can’t be taken over here.
en.Error_NotSignedIn: You are signed out. Please sign in again.
en.Error_StandardNotReady: The local proxy isn't ready yet. Please wait a moment.
en.connMethodHint: Changing it while connected reconnects with the new method.
en.methodEnhancedD: Works with all apps. Installs a system service on first use.
en.methodCompatibleD: Sets the system proxy; apps that follow it are proxied. No administrator permission needed.
en.routingRulesD: Routing rules decide what goes direct and what through the node.
en.routingGlobalD: Everything except the local network goes through the node.
en.Error_SystemProxyFailed: Couldn’t apply system proxy settings. Another app may be managing them.
en.Error_ConnectHealthCheckFailed: Connected, but the service couldn’t be reached. Another app may have taken over DNS or the network.
en.Error_CredentialStoreLocked: Your keychain or keyring is locked. You’ll be signed in again once it’s unlocked.
en.Error_SystemProxyUnavailable: This desktop doesn't expose system proxy settings. Use Enhanced Mode, or enter the local proxy in your apps.
